## R: Distribución Poisson

<div class="block-note mb-12">
<div class="block-body text-justify" style="font-size: 26px;">
Brotes de sigatoka por semana en banano, $\lambda=4.2$. Calcule $P(X=3)$, $P(X \leq 5)$, $P(X > 6)$, $P(X \geq 7)$ y $P(3 \leq X \leq 6)$.
</div>
</div>

<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: start;">

<div class="scrollable-code" style="min-width: 0;">

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| comment: ""
#| class-source: scrollable-code
lambda <- 4.2

# Exactamente 3 brotes
dpois(3, lambda)

# Menor o igual que 5
ppois(5, lambda)

# Estrictamente menor que 5
ppois(4, lambda)

# Mayor que 6
ppois(6, lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)

# Mayor o igual que 7
ppois(6, lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)

# Entre 3 y 6 (inclusive)
ppois(6, lambda) - ppois(2, lambda)
```
</div>

<div class="card card--info" style="font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.9;">
<strong><code>dpois(x, lambda): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X = x)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>ppois(q, lambda):</code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X \leq q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>ppois(q-1, lambda): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X < q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>lower.tail = FALSE: </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X > q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>ppois(q-1,...,FALSE): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(X \geq q)$</span><br><br>

<strong><code>ppois(b) - ppois(a-1): </code></strong>
<span class="text-slate" style="font-size: 24px;">$P(a \leq X \leq b)$</span>
</div>

</div>
